name: Flame
identity: Turn short-lived burns and card embers into a controlled burst. Heat rewards status pressure even when another type supplied it.
loop: Apply Burn or another damaging status → build Heat to three → keep the attack bonus, or spend Heat before it cools → mark discarded cards with Ember to rebuild.
statuses: Once per round, after an enemy takes damage from a status such as Burn or Poison, gain 1 Heat. While you have 3 or more Heat, your damaging Offensive ability deals 1 extra damage. At the start of Ongoing Effects, lose 1 Heat. Cards and abilities can spend Heat before it cools.

At the start of the next Ongoing Effects, this enemy takes 1 damage per Burn, then remove all Burn. The Burn is removed even if its damage is prevented. Burn applied during Ongoing Effects waits until the following round.

The next time a status would damage this enemy, remove 1 Kindling and increase that status damage by 1. If several status dice deal damage together, increase only one die’s damage. Use no more than 1 Kindling during each Ongoing Effects or other status-damage event. Remove unused Kindling at the end of the next Ongoing Effects.
Positive card mark · your discard pile · max 2 marked cards

Mark a card in your discard pile. When you next play that card, or damage permanently removes it, gain 1 Heat and erase its Ember. Drawing or discarding the card does nothing to Ember. Erase unused Embers at the end of the following round.
abilities: 4 / 5 / 6 damage and apply 1 Burn at every tier.
Gain 2 Heat and mark one card in your discard pile with Ember, if available.
Deal 4 damage. Optionally spend up to 2 enemy Burn when choosing this ability for +2 damage each; consumed Burn will not tick.
Deal 6 damage and apply 1 Kindling. Optionally spend 2 Heat when choosing this ability to apply 2 Burn as well.
Each Spark prevents 1; each Coal gains 1 Heat; any Crown applies 1 Burn to the attacker (maximum 1 from this defense).
Spark: prevent 2. Coal: prevent 3. Crown: prevent 2 and apply 1 Kindling to the attacker.
cards: Mark one card in your discard pile with Ember; requires an unmarked card in your discard pile.
Draw 1. If you already have Heat, mark one unmarked card in your discard pile with Ember.
Remove 1 Burn from an enemy to deal 2 damage to them with this card.
Spend 1 Heat. After your attack, apply 1 Kindling to that enemy. If the attack made them lose a health card, also apply 1 Burn.
Discard one additional hand card; gain 2 Heat. The discarded card can carry Ember but discarding does not trigger it.
Draw 2, then discard 1. Apply Ember to the discarded card if fewer than two of your cards have Ember.
Prevent 2 damage from one status. If this stops at least 1 damage, gain 1 Heat afterward.
Spend 2 Heat; gain 1 Energy and draw 1. Once per round.
Prevent 3 from one attack, card or status; spend 1 Heat as an additional cost.
Spend 1 Heat. The enemy’s rolled Defensive ability prevents up to 2 less damage from your attack, down to zero. Their cards and protective statuses still work normally.
Change one of your combat dice to 1 or 4. Your final dice must allow the ability you choose. You cannot change a Frostbound die.
Physically reroll one of your dice just rolled for a status, defense or card once; resolve its final face normally.
Prevent 1 damage from an enemy attack, card or status. If this stops any damage, apply 1 Burn to that enemy afterward.
Remove 1 Burn from yourself to gain 1 Heat. Requires that Burn.
Spend 1 Heat; stop 1 negative status stack an enemy is about to apply to you. Other stacks remain.
If you have no Heat, gain 1 Heat. Once per round.
Apply 1 Burn and 1 Kindling to the same enemy. The enemy can use cards or statuses that stop new negative stacks.
Upgrade once per battle: the first Ember trigger you resolve each round also draws 1 card.
Spend 2 Heat to prevent 5 damage from one attack, card or status.
Spend 3 Heat; apply 3 Burn divided among legal enemies, maximum 2 per enemy. With one enemy apply only 2.
pairs: Poison or Volatile Poison damage earns Heat once per round and can use Kindling. Flame benefits from Venom’s ongoing pressure without adding extra toxin rolls or replacing Catalyst.
Losing an Ember-marked card to damage can give Heat and a Corpse. Haunt can also earn Heat if the enemy chooses its status damage instead of paying the extra Energy.
Firebreak spends Heat to prevent attack damage. Stopping at least 2 earns Resolve, which can buy Fortify to protect Flame’s next combat result. Armor helps preserve Energy for Flame setup.
example: You enter Ongoing Effects with 3 Heat and lose 1, leaving 2. The enemy takes Poison damage, earning your once-per-round Heat and returning you to 3. Your next attack gains 1 damage. Spending Heat before the attack may lose that bonus.
counter: Remove damaging statuses before they earn Heat. Heat also cools on its own. Kindling expires, and stopping all of the increased damage stops Heat from being earned.
balance: Heat gives a single +1 attack bonus at three or four stacks; it does not add damage per stack. Burn at three stacks threatens 3 total damage before expiring. Kindling adds at most 1 during an Ongoing Effects segment. Values still need playtesting.
combos: Stoke provides 2 Heat. Cinderlash applies Burn, which can replenish Heat after it cools. Ember offers a second way to reach the three-Heat attack bonus.
Dry Tinder → Poison or Burn → Bellows
Kindling strengthens the next status damage. Bellows spends Heat to prepare more Kindling and possibly Burn, trading your immediate Heat threshold for later pressure.

Heat.job: Build and maintain a damage threshold.
Heat.example: At 3 Heat, your attack gains 1 damage without spending Heat. Spend 1 Heat on a card and you drop below that bonus.

Burn.job: One short burst of delayed damage.
Burn.example: Two Burn threaten 2 damage next Ongoing Effects. Removing one beforehand leaves only 1 damage.

Kindling.job: Make another damaging status more dangerous.
Kindling.example: A Poison die would deal 1 damage. Kindling raises that die to 2, without adding Poison or making another roll.

Ember.job: Recover Heat by cycling or losing a particular card.
Ember.example: You mark a discarded card, later draw it and play it. Playing it gives 1 Heat; drawing it did not.
